sourceTitle: How Banks Create Money From Nothing
title: Banks Don't Lend Your Deposits — They Create Money
hook: Banks do not lend out your deposits. They create the money.
question: Did you know that?

scenes.narration: Here's what almost nobody is taught. Banks do not lend out your savings. They create brand-new money when they lend.
When a bank approves a loan, it simply types the amount into your account. The loan creates the deposit, not the other way around.
That is where almost all money comes from. Around ninety-seven percent of money is created by private banks, not printed by the government.
scenes.label: not printed — lent into existence

scenes.narration: Take out a three hundred thousand dollar mortgage, and three hundred thousand dollars of new money just appeared, from nothing.
scenes.label: new money, from nothing

scenes.narration: Did you know that's how money actually works?
